target_act: Road Safety Amendment (Hoon Driving and Other Matters) Act 2011
raw: The purpose of this Act is— (a) to amend the Criminal Procedure Act 2009 to allow police prosecutors to appear on behalf of protective services officers in Magistrates' Court proceedings; and Victoria (b) to amend the Major Crime (Investigative Powers) Act 2004 to extend the operation of sections 49 and 50 of that Act; and (c) to amend section 2 of the Road Safety Amendment (Hoon Driving and Other Matters) Act 2011 relating to the commencement of that Act.
after "police force" insert "or a protective services officer appointed under Part VIA of the Police Regulation Act 1958". __________________
In section 49(12) of the Major Crime (Investigative Powers) Act 2004, for "1 January 2012" substitute "1 January 2016".
